lines: <pulse>Back</pulse> to feathers and shafts before that pile grows legs.
I have arrows to trim before the light goes.
Those bundles still need checking.
The rack is waiting and it has no patience.
I promised another batch by first bell.
Every point needs checking before it leaves my hands.
There is a bowstring I should have replaced this morning.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to the workshop. Crooked shafts do not fix themselves.
My knife is waiting where I left it.
I will see you later, if the work allows it.
The fletching table has been quiet too long.
That is enough talking. The arrows are not listening anyway.
I left glue warming and should check it.
Come by after I finish this bundle.
Good company, bad timing. I still have work.
I need daylight for the next set of feathers.
You reminded me about a job I left unfinished.
I should go before the wind picks up.
We can finish this conversation when both my hands are free.
I have kept the range waiting long enough.
